subject: Next: Pilot success criteria, owners, and proposed kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@quantisil.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: success criteria and owners

Samir / Olivia — thanks again for a good conversation this morning. Quick recap and a handful of asks so we can lock the pilot plan: 

Call recap (20 min):
- Goal: validate Redwood can reduce end-to-end extraction latency for Quantisil inference pipelines and lower per-inference cost by >=30% for production subset.
- Scope: 2 models (search ranking + inference enrichment), 3 dev environments (dev/stage/prod), 1 TB/day KV cache test window.

Asks / proposed next steps:
1) Confirm the top 2 success metrics we should measure during the pilot (what your team will consider a win). Suggested: latency (p50/p95), cost per 1k tokens, and inference correctness delta on 500 eval prompts.
2) Confirm internal owners we should work with for security, infra, and product (name + email).
3) Agree on proposed kickoff week: May 10–14. We can do a firm kickoff on May 10 or 11 depending on resource availability.
4) Please upload any security docs that your legal/procurement team will need (SOC2, data-flow diagrams).

I attached a one-page trial plan (Quantisil-trial-plan-v1.pdf) and a starter mutual-action-plan (mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx). If you can fill columns for "owner" and "target date" by EOD Tuesday (May 4), we'll lock the calendar.

Proposed owners from my side: Ben Carter (sales lead), Aditya Rao (solutions engineer), Monica Patel (customer success). I'll coordinate the kickoff agenda and weekly check-ins.

Thanks — looking forward to driving this forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Quantisil-trial-plan-v1.pdf, mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx

From: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@quantisil.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Shah <samir@quantisil.com>, procurement@quantisil.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: success criteria and owners

Thanks Marissa — good talk. Quick answers below and an attachment (security-questionnaire-completed.xlsx) we started with our security team.

Success metrics (what matters to our stakeholders):
- Primary: p95 latency reduction >= 25% on ranking model under 95th percentile load profile.
- Secondary: Cost per inference improvement >= 20% while maintaining inference correctness within 1.5% of baseline on our 500-sample holdout set.
- Ops: Must include token-level audit logs and KV cache eviction policy documented.

Owners (internal):
- Samir Shah (Product Lead) — samir@quantisil.com (technical acceptance)
- Olivia Tan (Program Manager) — olivia.tan@quantisil.com (project coordinator)
- procurement@quantisil.com (legal / commercial)
- Security contact: sec-contact@quantisil.com (they'll reach out for SOC2 artifacts)

Notes on timeline: procurement will need 48–72 hours to review any contract addendum. Security asked for our standard questionnaire answers which I attached. We can target a kickoff on May 11 (preferred) if your resources are available.

On the MAP: I'll populate initial owner columns and return by EOD Tuesday.

Cheers,
Olivia
Program Manager, Quantisil

Attachments: security-questionnaire-completed.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Tan <olivia.tan@quantisil.com>, Samir Shah <samir@quantisil.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, procurement@quantisil.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Draft mutual action plan + concrete owners/dates (please review)

Appended below is a compact mutual action plan (summary) — I updated owners/dates based on our conversation and Olivia's note. I've also created a shared Drive folder (link below) with the MAP and a short kickoff agenda. Please review and comment inline: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cQnt-Quantisil-MAP

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
- Week 0 (prep) — by May 7: Quantisil to share SOC2 evidence + data-flow diagram (owner: sec-contact@quantisil.com). Redwood to provide access checklist and deployment playbook (owner: Aditya Rao).
- Week 1 (kickoff & baseline) — May 11: Kickoff meeting, baseline throughput/latency capture (owner: Samir Shah / Aditya Rao).
- Week 2–4 (integration & tuning) — May 12–June 1: Model integration, KV cache tuning, batching optimization (owner: Aditya Rao / Monica Patel).
- Week 5 (eval & handoff) — June 7: Run 500-sample eval, produce pass/fail against success metrics; draft production roll plan (owner: Samir Shah / Monica Patel).

Questions and small asks:
- Olivia: can you confirm the security contact's best email (sec-contact@quantisil.com is correct?) and whether there are any IP/data residency constraints we should be aware of?
- Procurement: we'll prepare a trial addendum for signature (lightweight) — expected turnaround 48–72h.

I've attached the updated MAP and trial plan to this thread. If we get confirmation of availability, I propose we schedule kickoff for Tuesday, May 11 at 09:00 PT. If that's a problem, state your preferred window.

—
Marissa

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.xlsx (updated), Quantisil-trial-plan-v1.pdf

Subject: Confirmed: Kickoff May 11 @ 09:00 PT + kickoff agenda and short checklist

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Tuesday, May 11 at 09:00 PT. Calendar invite (CalendarInvite-Kickoff-May11.ics) attached. Brief agenda and immediate next steps below so the team knows what to prepare: 

Kickoff agenda (45–60m):
- 09:00–09:10 — Introductions & success metric alignment (Marissa / Samir)
- 09:10–09:25 — Baseline capture approach and access checklist (Aditya)
- 09:25–09:40 — Data handling & security Qs (Quantisil sec-contact / Monica)
- 09:40–09:55 — Integration plan and milestones (Aditya / Ben)
- 09:55–10:00 — Confirm owners, weekly check-in cadence (Fridays, 30m) and acceptance criteria (Samir)

Immediate checklist before kickoff:
- Quantisil: confirm sec-contact email and upload any outstanding SOC2 material to the Drive folder (owner: Olivia).
- Procurement: expect a short trial addendum from my team; please provide preferred signer and turnaround expectation.
- Redwood: Aditya will publish the access checklist to the Drive folder and Monica will schedule the weekly Friday 30m check-in recurring invite.

If anyone needs the kickoff outside the proposed time, please reply with 2 alternative windows by EOD today and we'll adjust. Otherwise we'll send calendar invites and a short meeting note after the kickoff.

Looking forward — let's keep momentum.

—
Marissa Cole
